pages.title: Where there is no air
pages.text: You cannot breathe on the Moon, Mars, asteroids, Venus or in GalaxySpace. Without tanks you lose health fast, and a normal torch goes out. $(l:space/survival/hazards)Plants and normal food$() need oxygen too.

pages.title: Supply
pages.text: The Oxygen Collector works anywhere on Earth. In a vacuum it only draws from nearby leaves or wheat, so bring your first supply with you. The Oxygen Compressor fills tanks from a collector.

pages.title: Gear
pages.text: A mask, oxygen gear, two tanks and a parachute. Tanks come as light, medium and heavy, with even larger ones in GalaxySpace. A heavier tank lasts longer.

pages.title: Oxygen bubble
pages.text: The Bubble Distributor makes an air bubble around itself. It is simple and needs no sealed walls, so it suits a first base. It needs power and oxygen through pipes from a collector.

pages.title: Oxygen Sealer
pages.text: Fills a closed room of up to 800 blocks with oxygen. Several sealers close together add up. It rechecks the room about every 5 seconds. Keep the space above and right next to the machine free.

pages.title: What holds air
pages.text: Plain solid blocks are the safest. Of glass, only glass blocks and panes work. Pipes and wires through a wall must be the sealable kind, as normal ones leak. Diagonal panes can leave a gap.

pages.title: Air Lock
pages.text: The door of a base: at least 7 Air Lock Frames and a controller. The controller needs meteoric iron, so you must reach the $(l:space/planets/moon)Moon$() first. Two locks in a row with a small room between them keep the air in.

pages.title: Important
pages.text: Oxygen in a room or a bubble stops both suffocation and vacuum damage. As soon as you step outside without a spacesuit, the vacuum hurts again. Read more in the $(l:space/survival/hazards#base)pressure entry$().

pages.title: Sealed base
pages.text: A sealer, an oxygen pipe and an air lock in the wall.

pages.title: Oxygen Collector
pages.text: Gathers oxygen from Earth's air or nearby leaves.

pages.title: Oxygen Compressor
pages.text: Fills tanks with oxygen from a collector.

pages.title: Oxygen Mask
pages.text: Tanks do not work without it.

pages.title: Oxygen Gear
pages.text: Connects the mask to the tanks.

pages.title: Heavy Oxygen Tank
pages.text: The largest tank in Galacticraft.

pages.title: Larger Tanks
pages.text: GalaxySpace tanks hold more oxygen than the Galacticraft heavy tank. Each tier is made from the previous one, and the first from a heavy tank. Tier 5 needs $(l:space/planets/jupiter#europa)Europa$() ice, tier 6 a $(l:space/planets/neptune#triton)Triton$() geyser. $(li)Tier 4: 3500 oxygen.$(li)Tier 5: 4000.$(li)Tier 6: 4500.

pages.title: EPP Tank
pages.text: Holds only 2500 oxygen, but refills itself while you stand in an oxygen bubble or sealed room. Built on the NASA Workbench from its own schematic. At the Modification Table it can be installed into tier 4-6 tanks, which then refill too.
